open_routes.mechanical_difference: Vanilla outlines the glyph through use/defs/path while crystalline emits an SVG text node; root style/namespace details also differ.
open_routes.l0_boundary: P1424 explicitly excludes equality of paths, symbol IDs, mechanical SVG attribute order and general byte identity.
open_routes.why_not_reclassified: The P1452 preseal freezes the P1420 full-tree projection byte-for-byte; changing it after candidate observation would invalidate the chain.

next_step.proposed: P1453 — refine the html.frame public projection before remeasurement
next_step.scope: Measure and freeze a language-level html.frame projection covering inline SVG identity, dimensions, viewBox, display semantics, visible text/paint and nesting while excluding renderer-private glyph outlines and IDs.
next_step.gate: New contract and discriminatory mutants must be sealed before reusing candidate outputs.

claim_boundary: Backlog for the one non-MATCH route in P1452; no general HTML/SVG parity claim.
